method.name: Frozen trajectory with bounded native launch forecasts
method.summary: Full-state native-model control: 850 hanging-settle commands, then a retained 650-command trajectory feedback prefix. At the observed launch state, a fixed ordered search selects the first of at most 11 cart-error offsets whose native forecast completes the remaining episode and upright hold; the live episode executes once.

notes: All 262 actual calibration/development/reserved episodes and 393,000 recorded commands were rescored from hash-verified saved tapes. The 7.34-second minimum and cart maximum cover all 262, not only held-out cases.

Native defect and initial-gap metrics cover the complete exact source-calibration episode: 1,500 cold transitions and a separate 1,500-command continuous native replay, both exact. They do not claim a cold native audit of all 393,000 commands.

An additional causal policy replay proved all 211,500 held-out raw binary64 and delivered float32 commands plus every selected 650-command shadow/live suffix, including final states, byte for byte. This is separate from native calibration coverage.

Selected forecast arrays are retained; rejected launch forecasts retain summaries rather than complete forecast arrays. Planning forecasts do not count as additional benchmark episodes or native audit coverage.
The previous static 17-second candidate failed 2 of 100 development cases before this profile-selector candidate was frozen. That negative cohort is preserved and is not counted toward this result.
